units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 19:25">Targ. Prov. XIX, 25</cite>.

<cite ref="Makkot 23b:14">Macc. 23ᵇ</cite> <he>ודילמא אִיעֲרוּמֵי מִיעַרְמָא</he> (not <he>איערומא</he>) might she not have been subtle enough (to discover Solomon’s motive)? <cite ref="Sanhedrin 25a:11">Snh. 25ᵃ</cite> <he>דילמא איערומי קא מַעֲרִים</he> perhaps he merely pretends (to be repentant)? <cite ref="Bava Metzia 90b:1">B. Mets. 90ᵇ</cite> <he>הערמה … אַעֲרִימוּ עלייהו ויזדבנון</he> a trick has been employed regarding them, use a trick against them (that did it), and let the oxen be sold (and not be used for ploughing).
